metrics_policy: Primary rank/coverage per study; Cambray linear-protein log2 errors only with calibration frozen on other development data. Kuo no fold-error/log2 conversion while log base unknown. No pooled-study ranking. Preserve missing/zero/negative and backend failures; no outlier trimming. Do not inspect final outcomes for tuning.
